# BeaEngine objects

`BeaEngineLib64.obj` and `BeaEngineLibFPC.obj` are the prebuilt BeaEngine
object files from the original Magicmida repository
(https://github.com/Hendi48/Magicmida), linked unmodified by this port.

BeaEngine is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v3
(LGPLv3). See `LICENSE.LGPL` in this directory. The public BeaEngine header
is mirrored by `src/disasm.h`; no separate BeaEngine headers are required by
the build.

Upstream source: https://github.com/BeaEngine/beaengine

The exact source corresponding to these objects is available from the
original Magicmida repository and the upstream BeaEngine project. If you
need a copy of the corresponding source, open an issue in this repository
and the maintainers will provide it.
